description: Checks selected registries (official MCP registry, PyPI, GitHub) for packages/servers tied to a domain or brand. A discovery-surface check (can agents find your published tooling?), not a visibility check. Use when you want to know whether a brand has discoverable agent/developer artifacts listed where agents look for them. Result: { state, score, tier, hits[], tool_schema_version }.

brand.description: Optional brand/company name; inferred from the domain when absent.

url.description: Absolute https URL of the target (any public domain).

name: probe_agent_discovery
title: Probe Agent Discovery Surfaces
